notes.title: Patch 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Hi! 

Are you interested in what's changed?

 some changes in auto hacking (now the game require a 999 score to start auto hacking)
 changed scripting backend to prevent glitches (before in some cases the whole globe was empty, now fewer devices will have this problem)
 fixed some translations

notes.title: Cyber Attack - Languages Update (v0.5)
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback regarding the operation of the virus system.

Version 0.5:
- new languages
- redesigned viruses system (now you have the ability to upgrade and control your viruses)
- reduced hacking time to 32 seconds
- new hacking UI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37088879/3ac70207e7ee3a2e932e22c1cd73f41fac0cffe2.png

Languages currently available in Cyber Attack:
- English
- Dutch (99%)
- French (99%)
- German (99%)
- Polish (99%)

Translation of other languages:
- Russian (85%)
- Ukrainian (63%)
- Hungarian (35%)
- Italian (31%)
- Turkish (11%)
- Spanish (5%)

If you want to help with translation visit this website:
https://www.localizor.com/cyber-attack


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37088879/dab930b75f7ddb0952c4beb10cf6e464c15af792.png

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37088879/c64272dd5c1967e7c5af39f112415835d3a770d0.png

Your feedback is very important so this update contains a completely new hacking system. 

Version 0.2 aka April Update has also more changes:
- cyber defense system
- bigger fonts and better contrast of texts
- some UI changes
- information about detection risk
- fix several bugs (and add new ones)
